(2) Near-duplicate fixed: q-028 (left lane, exit close, dense right lane) resolved to the same lesson as wave-1 q-007 (missed exit -> continue to next); rewritten to test timely pre-positioning before the exit (чл. 25) with correct answer at b. (7) Wave-2 distribution: 13 single / 8 multi (62/38); points 8x1 / 9x2 / 4x3 (38/43/19) — both within tolerance of the 60/40 and 40/40/20 targets. wave3.notes: Adversarial audit of wave-3 additions (q-044..q-064) 2026-07-08. (1) Schema: valid UTF-8 JSON, no trailing commas, all 21 ids unique and sequential, all conceptIds resolve in concepts.json, all 13 singles have exactly 1 correct option, all 8 multis have 2-3 correct; option ids a-d everywhere; media null; every question carries lawRefs. (2) MAJOR quality defect fixed — the same answer-position bias flagged in waves 1 and 2 came back worse: 12 of 13 wave-3 singles had the correct answer at position 'b' (only q-045 differed, at 'c'), which trains students to reflexively pick 'b'. Reshuffled 8 singles by swapping option texts: q-044 and q-051 and q-057 -> 'a'; q-049 and q-062 -> 'c'; q-047 and q-052 and q-055 -> 'd'. Final singles spread a:3/b:4/c:3/d:3, balanced. (3) Secondary pattern fixed: every multi had its correct set starting {a,b}, and all five 2-correct multis had answer set exactly {a,b} (learnable 'a and b are always right'). Reshuffled q-050 -> {a,c}, q-056 -> {a,d}, q-063 -> {a,c}; multi sets now varied (050:ac 054:ab 056:ad 059:abd 060:ab 061:abc 063:ac 064:abc). Total fixed = 11 (8 singles + 3 multis); all fixes were option-order swaps only — no stem, explanation, correctness, or law ref was changed. (4) Legal answers verified correct: overtaking only on the left / no passing on the right (чл. 42, q-044/055); 70 km/h car+trailer on ordinary road outside built-up vs 100 on motorway from wave-2 (чл. 21, q-045); following distance ~2 s (чл. 23, q-046/059); motorway regime begins at the 'Motorway' sign (чл. 54, q-047); dipped headlights + remove sunglasses at tunnel (чл. 70, q-049); glare/deer/herd/brake-fade/wrong-lane/wind conduct under чл. 20 and чл. 25 (q-051/053/054/057/058); lane discipline keep-right, left for overtaking (чл. 15/16, q-056); merge yields, one lane at a time after merging (чл. 55/25, q-060/063); stall in active lane -> hazards, everyone behind the barrier, call 112 (чл. 97, q-061); end-of-motorway reverts to 90 km/h and mixed traffic (чл. 21/54, q-064). No wrong correct answers found; nothing removed. (5) flaggedLegal=4 retained at needs-review with [REVIEW:] notes (substance correct, exact article unverified against consolidated ЗДвП): q-048 (U-turn/reversing ban on expressway — чл. 58 applicability), q-050 (rear fog light use — чл. 76?), q-052 (dip beams ~150 m on meeting — чл. 74?), q-062 (heavy goods vehicles barred from leftmost lane on 3+ lane motorway — чл. 16?). (6) Duplicate check against all 64 questions: q-058 (wrong lane at a motorway split -> stay in lane, fix after) is thematically adjacent to wave-1 q-007 (missed exit -> continue to next exit) but tests a distinct scenario/decision, kept; q-045 (trailer, ordinary road, 70) vs wave-2 q-024 (trailer, motorway, 100) are distinct; q-057 (brake fade emergency) vs wave-2 q-016 (long-descent technique) are distinct. No near-duplicates removed. (7) Distribution: 13 single / 8 multi (62/38); points 8x1 / 8x2 / 5x3 (38/38/24) — within tolerance of 60/40 and 40/40/20 targets. (8) No listovki-style copying; stems are original second-person scenarios; Bulgarian natural and teen-appropriate throughout.
